description: This file defines a custom Lexical node for embedding YouTube videos in a rich text editor. It includes a React component for rendering the YouTube iframe, the node class for serialization and DOM conversion, and utility functions for node creation and type checking.

classes.name: YouTubeNode
classes.description: A Lexical decorator node for embedding YouTube videos, handling serialization, DOM conversion, and rendering within the editor.

methods.name: convertYoutubeElement
methods.description: Converts an HTML iframe element with a data-lexical-youtube attribute into a YouTubeNode.

methods.name: $createYouTubeNode
methods.description: Factory function to create a new YouTubeNode with a specified video ID.

methods.name: $isYouTubeNode
methods.description: Type guard function to check if a node is a YouTubeNode.
